text.en:
The Project: Gintong Alay may import sport equipment, materials and other supplies as may be
required for the attainment of its objectives from its appropriations, contributions or other sources.
Such importations shall be fully exempted from customs duties, levies, charges or taxes of any kind.

All laws, decrees, orders, rules and regulations inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed,
amended or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of November, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty.
